books.title: Saurian Empire
books.shortText: DESTROY a book here; gain its Value again.
books.rulesText: On Assign: DESTROY another book assigned to this visitor. This visitor gains Fulfillment equal to that book's current Value. What it already contributed remains.
books.flavor: A study of the ancient saurian dominions: brutal civilizations in which monstrous reptilian rulers consumed everything beneath them and turned conquest into renewed strength.

rebinds.name: Imperial Edition
rebinds.text: Printed Value 4. Still DESTROYs another book here.

rebinds.name: Total Conquest
rebinds.text: On Assign: DESTROY another book assigned to this visitor. This visitor gains Fulfillment equal to twice that book's current Value.

rebinds.name: Saurian Supremacy
rebinds.text: On Assign: DESTROY all other books assigned to this visitor. This visitor gains Fulfillment equal to the sum of their current Values.

books.title: Dragon Compendium
books.shortText: Draw 1. If it is as big as this: +1 forever.
books.rulesText: On Assign: draw 1 book. If its current Value is equal to or greater than Dragon Compendium's current Value, Dragon Compendium permanently gains +1 Value.
books.flavor: An exhaustive scholarly reference on dragons — their anatomy, habits, powers, weaknesses, and the accumulated knowledge of generations who studied them.

rebinds.name: Expanded Compendium
rebinds.text: On Assign: draw 1 book. If its current Value is at least Dragon Compendium's, Dragon Compendium permanently gains +2 Value.

rebinds.name: Comparative Dracology
rebinds.text: On Assign: draw 2 books. If the higher current Value of the two is at least Dragon Compendium's, Dragon Compendium permanently gains +1 Value.

rebinds.name: Broad Criteria
rebinds.text: On Assign: draw 1 book. If its current Value is at least Dragon Compendium's current Value − 2, Dragon Compendium permanently gains +1 Value.

books.title: Eclipse of the Werebeasts
books.shortText: Once played, DESTROYed. 2 random hand books become Werebeasts (+2).
books.rulesText: On Assign: 2 random books in your hand each become a Werebeast until the end of the Encounter, whose Value is its current Value +2. Once played, this book is DESTROYed for the rest of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Blood Moon
rebinds.text: On Assign: 2 random books in your hand each become a Werebeast until the end of the Encounter, whose Value is its current Value +4. Once played, this book is DESTROYed for the rest of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Total Eclipse
rebinds.text: On Assign: 3 random books in your hand each become a Werebeast until the end of the Encounter, whose Value is its current Value +2. Once played, this book is DESTROYed for the rest of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Sudden Transformation
rebinds.text: On Assign: 2 random books in your hand each become a Werebeast (current Value +2) until the end of the Encounter. They cost 0 Actions this turn. Once played, this book is DESTROYed for the rest of the Encounter.

books.title: Monsters of the Deep
books.shortText: Tentacles assign 1 hand book, free, then DESTROY it.
books.rulesText: On Assign: tentacles take 1 random book from your hand and assign it to a randomly chosen valid visitor for 0 Actions. Its On Assign ability resolves. Then DESTROY it.
books.flavor: A lavish bestiary documenting krakens, leviathans, and other colossal creatures said to inhabit the deepest and least-charted seas.

rebinds.name: Deeper Still
rebinds.text: Printed Value 4. Tentacles still take 1 book, and still DESTROY it.

rebinds.name: More Tentacles
rebinds.text: On Assign: tentacles take 2 random books from your hand and assign them to randomly chosen valid visitors for 0 Actions. Their On Assign abilities resolve. Then DESTROY them.

rebinds.name: Softer Tentacles
rebinds.text: On Assign: tentacles take 1 random book from your hand and assign it to a randomly chosen valid visitor for 0 Actions. Its On Assign ability resolves. It is not DESTROYed.

books.title: Apex Predator
books.shortText: Ignores visitor abilities that affect it.
books.rulesText: Ignores visitor abilities that affect this book — changing its Value or cost, moving, discarding or DESTROYing it. Visitor-wide conditions still apply.

rebinds.name: Perfect Predator
rebinds.text: Printed Value 10. Still ignores visitor abilities.

rebinds.name: Unstoppable Predator
rebinds.text: Assigning this copy costs 0 Actions. Still Value 7; still ignores visitor abilities.

rebinds.name: Predator's Instinct
rebinds.text: Ignores visitor abilities that affect this book. On Assign: draw 1 book.

books.title: Mireborn
books.shortText: Costs 0 Actions with 5+ books in discard.
books.rulesText: Costs 0 Actions if your discard pile contains 5 or more books.

rebinds.name: Deep Mire
rebinds.text: Costs 0 Actions if your discard pile contains 3 or more books.

rebinds.name: Bog Giant
rebinds.text: Printed Value 5. Still costs 0 Actions with 5+ books in discard.

rebinds.name: Sinking Ground
rebinds.after: When drawn: discard top 2 of Library
rebinds.text: Costs 0 Actions if your discard pile contains 5 or more books. When drawn, discard the top 2 books of your Library.

books.title: The Pale Watcher
books.shortText: Effect-discarded or DESTROYed: +2 Value, assign randomly instead.
books.rulesText: If discarded or DESTROYed by an effect, assign this to a random valid visitor instead and give it +2 Value.

rebinds.name: Unblinking Watcher
rebinds.text: If discarded or DESTROYed by an effect, assign this to a random valid visitor instead and give it +4 Value.

rebinds.name: Many-Eyed
rebinds.text: If discarded or DESTROYed by an effect, assign this to a random valid visitor instead and give it +2 Value. If it is assigned this way, draw 1 book.

rebinds.name: Never Lost
rebinds.text: If discarded or DESTROYed by an effect, it gains +2 Value and is assigned to a random valid visitor instead. If there is none, it returns to your hand instead.

books.title: Whispers of Blackwater
books.shortText: Return a random discarded book; +1 Value this Encounter.
books.rulesText: On Assign: return 1 random book from your discard pile to your hand. It gains +1 Value until the end of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Louder Whispers
rebinds.text: On Assign: return 1 random book from your discard pile to your hand. It gains +3 Value until the end of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Many Voices
rebinds.text: On Assign: return 2 random different books from your discard pile to your hand. Each gains +1 Value until the end of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Blackwater Passage
rebinds.after: +1 Value this Encounter; costs 0 this turn
rebinds.text: On Assign: return 1 random book from your discard pile to your hand. It gains +1 Value until the end of the Encounter and costs 0 Actions this turn.

books.title: The Tide of Teeth
books.rulesText: This book's Value is equal to the number of books in your discard pile, to a maximum of 4.

rebinds.name: Feeding Frenzy
rebinds.text: This book's Value is equal to the number of books in your discard pile, to a maximum of 7.

rebinds.name: Blood in the Water
rebinds.text: This book's Value is equal to the number of books in your discard pile, to a maximum of 4. On Assign: if The Tide of Teeth has Value 4, draw 1 book.

rebinds.name: Endless Teeth
rebinds.after: On Assign: a Temporary copy to your hand
rebinds.text: This book's Value is equal to the number of books in your discard pile, to a maximum of 4. On Assign: put a Temporary copy of The Tide of Teeth into your hand (not Rebound; it fades at End Turn if unused).

books.title: The Starless Sea
books.shortText: Ignore visitor abilities this turn. DESTROY at End Turn.
books.rulesText: On Assign: ignore all visitor abilities for the rest of this turn. DESTROY this at End Turn.

rebinds.name: Black Horizon
rebinds.text: Printed Value 5. Still costs 0, ignores visitor abilities this turn and is DESTROYed at End Turn.

rebinds.name: Depthless Silence
rebinds.text: On Assign: ignore all visitor abilities for the rest of this turn, then draw 1 book. DESTROY this at End Turn.

rebinds.name: After the Darkness
rebinds.after: DESTROYed at End Turn: +1 Action next turn
rebinds.text: On Assign: ignore all visitor abilities for the rest of this turn. DESTROY this at End Turn; when it is, gain +1 Action next turn.

books.title: Werebeast
books.rulesText: A book transformed by Eclipse of the Werebeasts. It has no ability, costs 1 Action whatever the original cost, and turns back when the Encounter ends.

books.title: A Good Story
books.rulesText: If this visitor has no other books assigned, this visitor gains 2 Fulfillment.

curios.name: Underjade Colorings
curios.text: Books assigned to a visitor on the turn that visitor arrives gain +1 Value.

curios.name: Talisman of the Anger
curios.text: Books assigned to a visitor at 1 Patience gain +1 Value.

curios.name: Hypnotic Necklace
curios.text: Merchants offer an additional Curio, and the first time you refresh their wares at each Merchant it is free.

curios.name: Talisman of the After-After Life
curios.text: Whenever your discard pile is shuffled into your Library, a random book shuffled in gains +1 Value until the end of the Encounter.

curios.name: Gold Ink
curios.text: Whenever you fulfill a visitor exactly at their Need, gain 3 Gold.

curios.name: Lost Tome
curios.text: When two books in a row played from your hand use your two different Traits, the third book gains +1 Value.

curios.name: Special Crown
curios.text: Books assigned to visitors who have a visitor ability gain +1 Value.

curios.name: Lovely Waiting Stew
curios.text: The first time each Encounter that 4 or more visitors are waiting at the start of a turn, they all gain +1 Fulfillment.

curios.name: Occult Riddle
curios.text: After you have fulfilled 20 visitors while carrying it, gain a Rare Summon and destroy this Curio.

curios.name: Timelock Amber
curios.text: The first time each Encounter that you fulfill a visitor on the turn they arrive, gain +1 Action and draw 1 next turn.

curios.name: The Volume II
curios.text: Basic books gain +1 Value.

curios.name: Braided Catalogue
curios.text: Every 3rd alternation in a row between your two Traits on paid assignments gains you +1 Action. A neutral book breaks the chain; it resets each Encounter.

curios.name: Empyrean Wax
curios.text: While 4 or more visitors are waiting, every book gains +1 Value.

curios.name: Animating Chains
curios.text: Once a visitor holds a book of each of your two Traits, every further book assigned to them gives +1 Fulfillment more.

curios.name: Orb of Remorse
curios.text: When a visitor's ability lowers a book's Value, or discards or DESTROYs one of your books, books you assign to that visitor gain +1 Value for the rest of the Encounter.

curios.name: Queue Delicacies
curios.text: Whenever you fulfill a visitor while 4 or more others are still waiting, gain 5 Gold.

curios.name: Lost Epochs Ring
curios.text: Once per Encounter: the moment every waiting visitor has a book assigned, draw 1 extra book at random from your discard pile next turn.

curios.name: Sleepless Lantern
curios.text: Once per Encounter: if you fulfill 2 or more visitors in a turn, nobody loses Patience at the end of that turn.

curios.name: Queue Collapse Counter
curios.text: While 5 or more visitors are waiting, every 3rd book you assign costs 0 Actions. The count carries through the Encounter.

curios.name: Hostile Reader's Seal
curios.text: Books assigned to visitors who have a visitor ability gain +2 Value. Ordinary visitors get nothing.

curios.name: Second Opinion
curios.text: If the last book assigned to a visitor was of your other Trait, the book you assign them now gains +2 Value. It can alternate again and again; a neutral book breaks that visitor's chain.

curios.name: Deep Waiting-Room Clock
curios.text: The first book assigned to a visitor each turn gains +1 Value for every 2 Patience they have, up to +2.

curios.name: The Great Alternating Index
curios.text: Every 3rd alternation in a row between your two Traits on paid assignments refunds 1 Action, and that book gains +2 Value. A neutral book breaks the chain.

curios.name: The Endless Waiting Room
curios.text: If you fulfill 2 or more visitors in a turn, everyone still waiting gains +1 Patience at the end of that turn instead of losing 1.

curios.name: The People's Catalogue
curios.text: Whenever you fulfill a visitor, every other waiting visitor gains +1 Fulfillment.

curios.name: Perfectly Balanced Inventory
curios.text: While your deck holds exactly as many books of one of your Traits as of the other, books of either Trait gain +2 Value. Neutral books are not counted.

curios.name: The Retinue's Book of Etiquette
curios.text: Whenever a new wave of visitors arrives, everyone already waiting gains +1 Fulfillment.

curios.name: The Difficult Customer Society
curios.text: Whenever a visitor's ability lowers a book's Value, or discards or DESTROYs one of your books, that book first gains +2 Value.

curios.name: The Great Queue Ledger
curios.text: Every 5th visitor you fulfill gains you +1 Action at once. The count carries across the Stage and resets when a new Stage begins.

curios.name: Two Schools, One Library
curios.text: Whenever a paid assignment alternates from one of your Traits to the other, that book gains +1 Value; every 4th alternation in a row also draws 1 book, if your hand has room. A neutral book breaks the chain.

curios.name: The Crooked Hourglass
curios.text: In each Bookselling Encounter, the first visitor to arrive with more than 1 Patience arrives with −1 Patience.

curios.name: The Lead Bookmark
curios.text: The first assignment you pay Actions for in each Bookselling Encounter costs +1 Action. Free assignments neither trigger nor use it.

curios.name: The Worm-Eaten Slip
curios.text: At the start of each Bookselling Encounter, one random book in your opening hand gets −1 Value for that Encounter.

curios.name: The Funeral Receipt
curios.text: The first walkout each Stage also costs 15 Gold.

curios.name: The Rusted Cashbox
curios.text: Every Merchant price is +15 Gold.

curios.name: The Moth-Eaten Map
curios.text: The first Finding each Stage gives no Gold. Its Fragments and Summon roll still resolve.

curios.name: The Customs Stamp
curios.text: Taking a Treasure also costs 15 Gold (down to 0 if you have less).

curios.name: The Smudged Catalogue
curios.text: The first Summon you open each Stage reveals only 1 title instead of 2.

curios.name: The Warped Press
curios.text: The first Rebind you perform each Stage reveals only 1 Edition instead of 2.

curios.name: The Spoiled Ribbon
curios.text: The first book you take from a Summon each Stage gets −1 Value until the Stage ends.

curios.name: The Cracked Reliquary
curios.text: Curio Shrine offerings cost 4 / 7 / 11 / 16 Fragments instead of 3 / 6 / 10 / 15. Merchant prices are unchanged.

curios.name: The Jealous Idol
curios.text: The first positive Curio you gain each Stage is Dormant — owned, but doing nothing — until the next Stage begins.

curios.name: The Greedy Saint
curios.text: Whenever you complete a Curio Shrine offering, it takes 1 more Curio Fragment after you choose your Curio, if you have one left.

encounters.name: Lantern Queue
encounters.purpose: The clean baseline: a busy counter of small orders. 16 / 23 / 30.

encounters.name: Closing Shift
encounters.purpose: The first small P1 emergency, at a Need the starter deck can answer. 16 / 22 / 29.

encounters.name: Serious Readers
encounters.purpose: Slightly larger, patient readers rather than emergency triage. 17 / 23 / 30.

encounters.name: After the Lecture
encounters.purpose: Several people arriving in a compressed period - width, not weight. 16 / 22 / 29.

encounters.name: Pilgrims Below
encounters.purpose: A steady procession of the devout. 17 / 23 / 30.

encounters.name: Dockworkers' Break
encounters.purpose: Concurrency, with the Runner supplying the P1 urgency. 16 / 23 / 30.

encounters.name: The Guild Delegation
encounters.purpose: Sequencing: the Guildmaster waits on his Clerk, who walks in with him. 18 / 25 / 34.

encounters.name: The Occult Collector
encounters.purpose: An opportunity, not a punishment: the Collector doubles On Assign, while his Bodyguard takes the first book. 47 total.

encounters.name: The Headless Academic
encounters.purpose: A long project that draws, against a stream of Assistants who cost you your hand. 55 total.

encounters.name: The Warlock's Retinue
encounters.purpose: The Warlock eats your recurrent deck; his retinue gives it back. 65 total.

intro.title: The Warlock
intro.line: Don't worry. I only eat the good ones.

encounters.name: The Funeral Procession
encounters.purpose: Tend every Mourner or the Duchess runs out of Patience; she lends you an Action while she waits. 70 total.

intro.title: The Duchess
intro.line: Three husbands. Not one of them finished a book.

encounters.name: Freshly Exhumed
encounters.purpose: Introductory recycle and positive assignment modifiers. 38 / 49 / 62.

encounters.name: The Bone Sorters
encounters.purpose: Discard growth and a tall slow project. 27 / 37 / 49.

encounters.name: After-After Mass
encounters.purpose: A deliberately wider Ossuary Normal. 31 / 40 / 51.

encounters.name: The Hungry Dead
encounters.purpose: Recognisable discard-count zombie pressure. 27 / 38 / 50.

encounters.name: Parish Registry
encounters.purpose: Urgency and a readable discard threshold. 30 / 41 / 54.

encounters.name: The Long Reading
encounters.purpose: Tall, slow developed-deck normal. 26 / 37 / 50.

encounters.name: The Bone Exchange
encounters.purpose: A full discard helps one customer and hurts another. 35 / 49 / 68.

encounters.name: Office of Reanimation
encounters.purpose: Forced discard becomes Clerk fuel. 34 / 49 / 67.

encounters.name: The Undertakers' Reading Circle
encounters.purpose: Keep discard full or cash it in. 35 / 52 / 72.

encounters.name: The Charnel King's Audience
encounters.purpose: Create low-discard attack windows against the King. 47 / 62 / 90.

intro.title: The Charnel King
intro.line: Kneel. Or don't. The knees go first anyway.

encounters.name: Mass of the After-After-Life
encounters.purpose: The recycle-event centerpiece. 56 / 70 / 101.

intro.title: The Archbishop
intro.line: We've died twice. We'd like something lighter this time.

encounters.name: Low Tide
encounters.purpose: The teaching pair: see the catch, then cast. 44 / 58 / 73.

encounters.name: The Fish Market
encounters.purpose: The tithe runs the Library fast; recycles come early. 45 / 59 / 73.

encounters.name: The Town Records
encounters.purpose: Tall, slow projects; the next book says which to save. 35 / 49 / 65.

encounters.name: The Net-Menders
encounters.purpose: A wide crowd and blind fishing. 41 / 53 / 68.

encounters.name: After the Hymn
encounters.purpose: The congregation tithes behind a slow elder. 33 / 46 / 64.

encounters.name: Fog on the Harbour
encounters.purpose: You can see what is coming; the locals will not wait. 43 / 56 / 71.

encounters.name: High Water
encounters.purpose: Keep your books, or feed the priest. 47 / 61 / 84.

encounters.name: Warnings on the Sea Wall
encounters.purpose: Fish the bad omen out before you end the turn. 46 / 62 / 83.

encounters.name: The Keeper's Light
encounters.purpose: Everyone fishes by her light while she waits. 38 / 52 / 77.

encounters.name: The Crowning of the Tide
encounters.purpose: The top of the Library, three ways to change it. 69 / 88 / 124.

intro.title: The Crowned Priestess
intro.line: Give what the sea gives you. It always comes back for it.

encounters.name: The Captain's Homecoming
encounters.purpose: How much of the family do you give to the sea? 61-97 / 78-123 / 112-157.

intro.title: The Old Captain
intro.line: The sea keeps its word, lad. So does family.

encounters.name: First Pitch
encounters.purpose: Tutorial: hand, Need, Actions, Overachievement, Patience, a walkout and the recycle.

encounters.name: The Top Step
encounters.purpose: Tutorial Boss: a headliner, a visitor ability, and the run's two new books.

intro.title: Sir Nobody
intro.line: Three hundred years I have guarded this stair. Nobody ever brought a book.

abilities.name: Protocol
abilities.text: Cannot be assigned books while the Guild Clerk remains unfulfilled.

abilities.name: Insatiable Curiosity
abilities.text: On Assign abilities of books assigned here trigger twice.

abilities.name: First in Line
abilities.text: The first book you assign each turn must be assigned to him.

abilities.name: Where Did I Put That?
abilities.text: The first time each turn you assign a book here, draw 1.

abilities.name: Keep Up
abilities.text: When the Academic receives their second book each turn, discard a random book from your hand.

abilities.name: Forbidden Offering
abilities.text: After a book assigned here resolves, DESTROY it for the rest of this Encounter. Fulfillment already produced remains.

abilities.name: Release the Binding
abilities.text: When fulfilled, return one book destroyed by the Warlock to the discard pile.

abilities.name: Broken Chain
abilities.text: When fulfilled, return every book destroyed by the Warlock to the discard pile.

abilities.name: Unattended Grief
abilities.text: At the end of any turn this Mourner received no book, the Duchess loses 1 Patience.

abilities.name: Noblesse Oblige
abilities.text: While she waits, you have +1 Action each turn.

abilities.name: Last Rites
abilities.text: Whenever you fulfill a visitor, draw 1.

abilities.name: Turned Earth
abilities.text: While he waits, every book that enters your discard pile gets +1 Value until it is next played. This stacks.

abilities.name: Read to Me
abilities.text: The first book you give him each turn gains +3 Value.

abilities.name: Returned to the Stacks
abilities.text: When fulfilled, return a random book from your discard pile to the top of your Library.

abilities.name: Slow Reader
abilities.text: May receive at most 1 book each turn.

abilities.name: Well-Read Bones
abilities.text: The first book assigned here each turn gets +1 Value per book in discard, max +3.

abilities.name: Hungry for Quiet
abilities.text: The first book assigned here each turn gets -1 Value per book in discard, max -3.

abilities.name: Restless
abilities.text: At End Turn, if no book was assigned here this turn, lose 1 additional Patience.

abilities.name: Filed for Later
abilities.text: The first book discarded each turn gains +1 Value until the end of this Encounter.

abilities.name: Registry Complete
abilities.text: When fulfilled, if your discard has 3 or more books, draw 1 and gain 1 Action.

abilities.name: Reclaimed Volume
abilities.text: When fulfilled, return a random book from your discard pile to your hand.

abilities.name: Paperwork Seized
abilities.text: On arrival, discard a random book from your hand.

abilities.name: Reanimation Papers
abilities.text: The first time each turn you fulfill another visitor, return a random book from discard to hand. If discard had 3+ books, it costs 0 Actions this turn.

abilities.name: Prepared Cadaver
abilities.text: If discard has 3 or more books, the first book assigned here each turn costs 0 Actions.

abilities.name: Enthusiastic Conversion
abilities.text: If discard has 3 or more books, the first book assigned here each turn gets +3 Value.

abilities.name: Braaaains
abilities.text: At the start of each turn, if your discard pile holds 3 or more books, gain +2 Fulfillment.

abilities.name: Eager
abilities.text: At End Turn, if no book was assigned here this turn, lose 1 additional Patience.

abilities.name: Lost!
abilities.text: At End Turn, if 3 or more visitors are waiting, lose 1 additional Patience.

abilities.name: After-After Resurrection
abilities.text: Whenever the normal full discard-to-Library recycle occurs, gain +4 Fulfillment.

abilities.name: Watch the Water
abilities.text: While this visitor waits, the top book of your Library is face-up.

abilities.name: Cast a Line
abilities.text: Once each turn, you may assign the top book of your Library here, for 1 Action.

abilities.name: Tithe to the Tide
abilities.text: At End Turn, the top book of your Library is tithed to the tide: it goes to your discard pile.

abilities.name: Flotsam
abilities.text: Whenever a book is tithed to the tide while he waits, he gains +1 Fulfillment.

abilities.name: Bad Omen
abilities.text: While he waits, the top book of your Library is face-up. At End Turn, if it has Value 2 or less, he loses 1 additional Patience.

abilities.name: Beacon
abilities.text: While she waits, the top book of your Library is face-up, and every waiting visitor may be fished once each turn.

abilities.name: Good Catch
abilities.text: A book fished here gets +2 Value.

abilities.name: Salvage
abilities.text: When fulfilled, draw the surfaced book.

abilities.name: Offerings from the Sea
abilities.text: While she waits, the top book of your Library is face-up. She accepts only books fished from your Library, and may be fished twice each turn.

abilities.name: The Bargain Kept
abilities.text: At End Turn, if a book was tithed to the tide this turn, he loses no Patience.

abilities.name: Sea-Change
abilities.text: Each book assigned here gets -1 Value. At the end of their second turn waiting, they turn: +15 Need, and they Tithe to the Tide.

traits.name: Royal
traits.pitch: Reach the whole room at once
